# Standalone plugin: public SDK, libcurl, SQLite only. No editor library linkage.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
    project(DoDevHttpClient VERSION 1.0.0 LANGUAGES CXX)
    include(GNUInstallDirs)
    enable_testing()
    option(DODEV_BUILD_TESTS "Build plugin tests" ON)
    set(DODEV_SDK_INCLUDE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include" CACHE PATH "Directory containing dodev/sdk")
else()
    set(DODEV_SDK_INCLUDE "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
endif()
find_package(PkgConfig QUIET)
if(PkgConfig_FOUND)
    pkg_check_modules(HTTP_CURL QUIET IMPORTED_TARGET libcurl)
endif()
if(TARGET PkgConfig::HTTP_CURL)
    set(http_curl PkgConfig::HTTP_CURL)
else()
    find_package(CURL QUIET)
    if(TARGET CURL::libcurl)
        set(http_curl CURL::libcurl)
    endif()
endif()
find_package(SQLite3 QUIET)
if(NOT http_curl OR NOT SQLite3_FOUND)
    if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "HTTP Client requires libcurl and SQLite3 development libraries")
    endif()
    message(WARNING "HTTP Client plugin skipped: install libcurl and SQLite3 development libraries")
    return()
endif()
add_library(dodev_http_client_core STATIC src/HttpClient.cpp)
set_target_properties(dodev_http_client_core PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_compile_features(dodev_http_client_core PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_include_directories(dodev_http_client_core PUBLIC include)
target_link_libraries(dodev_http_client_core PUBLIC ${http_curl} SQLite::SQLite3)
add_library(dodev_http_client_plugin MODULE src/HttpPlugin.cpp)
target_include_directories(dodev_http_client_plugin PRIVATE "${DODEV_SDK_INCLUDE}")
target_link_libraries(dodev_http_client_plugin PRIVATE dodev_http_client_core)
set(dir "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/plugins/http-client")
set_target_properties(dodev_http_client_plugin PROPERTIES LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${dir}" RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${dir}")
foreach(cfg IN LISTS CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
    string(TOUPPER "${cfg}" cfg)
    set_target_properties(dodev_http_client_plugin PROPERTIES LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${cfg} "${dir}" RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${cfg} "${dir}")
endforeach()
if(WIN32)
    set_target_properties(dodev_http_client_plugin PROPERTIES PREFIX "")
elseif(APPLE)
    set_target_properties(dodev_http_client_plugin PROPERTIES SUFFIX ".dylib")
endif()
configure_file(plugin.json "${dir}/plugin.json" COPYONLY)
install(TARGETS dodev_http_client_plugin LIBRARY DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}/plugins/http-client" RUNTIME DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}/plugins/http-client")
install(FILES plugin.json DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}/plugins/http-client")
if(DODEV_BUILD_TESTS)
    add_executable(http_client_tests tests/test_http.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(http_client_tests PRIVATE dodev_http_client_core)
    find_package(Python3 QUIET COMPONENTS Interpreter)
    if(Python3_Interpreter_FOUND AND CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
        add_test(NAME http_client_local COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/local_server.py" "$<TARGET_FILE:http_client_tests>")
    endif()
endif()
